What an incredible night it was - and you made sure to let the whole country feel it! We landed #1 Trending in the Philippines with WILLCAVILLE MEETS OPM, hitting 379K posts plus, and proudly secured #3 with #MEOWsikaAtBARKadahan at 330K posts.

This isn’t just about numbers. It’s about the love, unity, and unstoppable spirit of this fandom that continues to break barriers and set new milestones. Every tweet, every post, every mention you made counted, and look where it brought us! 🩷🩵

To each Willcatcher, who took the time to trend, engage, and rally behind this event - thank you isn’t enough. You reminded everyone how loud, passionate, and solid this family truly is.

Let’s continue writing these moments together. 🩷🩵
